label: TRIVIAL
trivial_evidence: metadata-side-effect-handler-registry.service.ts discoverAndRegisterHandlers() only registers providers carrying METADATA_SIDE_EFFECT_HANDLER_METADATA_KEY, which only MetadataSideEffectHandler() sets (base-metadata-side-effect-handler.service.ts); a service not extending it is never registered as a side-effect handler
reason: All 36 handler services (example, workflow-version-on-delete, object-search-vector-on-update) extend MetadataSideEffectHandler({...}); with no outliers, a service that does not is silently skipped by the registry, which only picks up classes with the metadata the factory sets, so the handler is never registered. Hesitated with ACCEPT because the skip is silent rather than an error.

label: ACCEPT
reason: Palette exports (amber.ts, blue.ts) give light/dark pairs to token(), and the only outlier is the index.ts COLOR_TOKENS aggregator (one_off); token(value: string | {light; dark}) accepts a bare string, so a new palette without dark values compiles and would silently reuse light colors in dark mode, worth flagging. clear:false because members themselves call token('...') without dark for step 9 and mainColors.ts passes only via its gray override; hesitated with WRONG mixed_group for alias maps.

label: TRIVIAL
trivial_evidence: workspace-migration-runner-action-handler-registry.service.ts registers only providers with WORKSPACE_MIGRATION_ACTION_HANDLER_METADATA_KEY, set by WorkspaceMigrationRunnerActionHandler() in interfaces/workspace-migration-runner-action-handler-service.interface.ts; getActionHandler() then throws 'No migration runner action handler found for action' on first use
reason: All 126 action-handler services (example, delete-webhook, update-view-sort) extend WorkspaceMigrationRunnerActionHandler(type, metadataName); with no outliers, a handler that does not lacks the metadata key, is never registered, and the registry throws 'No migration runner action handler found' the first time that action runs.
